responsibility: This file is gfortran’s bridge to GCC’s language hooks and backend initialization. It defines the Fortran-specific lang_identifier/lang_tree_node wrappers, registers langhooks for option handling, parsing, types, OpenMP interactions, diagnostics metadata such as SARIF language, and attribute tables, initializes built-in types and target/runtime builtins for the front end, and provides backend-facing startup/finish glue for the f951 compiler.
